# Observation-stream events

Events the kernel records on its observation stream (`KernelCallAuthority.observe`; read with `BrudKernel.readObservations()`). Diagnostics only — not a delivery mechanism.

| `events.pull.refused` | `brud.core.events` | `packages/kernel/services/Events/orchestrator/EventsService.ts` |

| `interception.blocked` | `brud.core.interception` | `packages/kernel/services/Interception/orchestrator/InterceptionService.ts` |
| `interception.failed` | `brud.core.interception` | `packages/kernel/services/Interception/orchestrator/InterceptionService.ts` |
